construction.implementation_origin: Original isolated reference implementation, authored in this directory.

shared_schema.input: Synthetic flag, customer {customer_id,name,goal,role,experience}, query, optional limit 1..20, ERP/MES work_orders, telemetry_csv, quality_inspections.
shared_schema.entities: Work orders contain fictitious assets, products, positive quantities, status and attributed maintenance logs. Telemetry and inspections reference an existing matching work order/asset.
shared_schema.measurements: Supported metric/unit pairs: temperature/C, vibration/mm/s, diameter/mm. Finite numeric values, ordered inclusive tolerances and basic physical bounds are required. Telemetry times are timezone-aware and chronological per asset/metric.
shared_schema.output: Versioned status/stage/customer/query envelope; search has ranked typed records, source evidence, all safety alerts and attributed quality decisions; onboarding carries the validated search envelope, one personalized next_step and human_escalations.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function dispatches input/search/onboarding boundaries, sharing primitive and measurement validation. CLI errors are JSON status:error with exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input becomes a normalized record collection for the local search index.
Ranked search hits are checked against source records, then consumed directly by onboarding.
Customer, query, work-order links, quality evidence and all safety alerts survive the handoff, even with no search hits.

behavior.search: Concept-normalized inverted index with a small explicit synonym vocabulary; weighted query coverage; descending score then record-ID tie break; positive-score results only.
behavior.embedding: Optional Python callable receives query and document strings in one batch. Finite same-dimension nonzero vectors are validated. Scores combine 65% lexical coverage and 35% nonnegative cosine. No live provider.
behavior.onboarding: Personalized by role, name, goal, experience and top search evidence. No hits prompt query refinement. Any safety-critical out-of-tolerance reading or failed inspection overrides normal onboarding and routes to a human safety supervisor.
behavior.quality_traceability: Demonstrative ISO 9001-oriented traceability: attributed timestamped inspection decisions, rationale, measurements, units, tolerances and work-order/asset references are retained. Decisions must match evidence. No compliance certification claims.
behavior.fixture: Clearly labeled invented customers, assets and maintenance logs with physically plausible seeded randomized telemetry.

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exit 0, one valid JSON object, status ok, stage onboarding.
test_outcomes.cli_errors: Verified missing arguments, missing file, malformed JSON and invalid schema produce JSON status error and exit 2.
test_outcomes.isolation: Verified exactly the four requested deliverables; no bytecode or scratch files.
